data.notes: January leans local, with brass-band residencies, Tipitina's anniversary shows, Jazz Market headliners, and the first big Carnival-linked music party of the season.

events.title: The Headhunters at New Orleans Jazz & Blues Market
events.summary: The Herbie Hancock-associated jazz-funk group The Headhunters played New Orleans Jazz & Blues Market, with drummer Mike Clark's official tour calendar listing the January 10 New Orleans date.

events.title: An Intimate Acoustic Evening with Gregory Alan Isakov
events.summary: Singer-songwriter Gregory Alan Isakov brought an intimate acoustic show to the Orpheum Theater on January 14.

events.title: The Radiators 2026 Anniversary at Tipitina's
events.summary: New Orleans favorites The Radiators held a three-night anniversary run at Tipitina's, with the venue calendar listing shows on January 15, 16, and 17.

events.title: Herb Alpert & The Tijuana Brass & Other Delights
events.summary: Trumpeter Herb Alpert brought his Tijuana Brass program to the Orpheum Theater for an all-ages January 16 concert.

events.title: AYYBO Live at The Rabbit Hole
events.summary: Bass-house artist AYYBO played The Rabbit Hole in a club-focused early-evening event organized through Eventbrite by the venue.

events.title: Rebirth Brass Band at The Rabbit Hole
events.summary: Rebirth Brass Band's January 20 appearance at The Rabbit Hole continued the Grammy-winning brass band's long-running Tuesday-night New Orleans tradition.

events.title: The Floozies + Too Many Zooz: Too Many Flooz Tour
events.summary: Electro-funk duo The Floozies teamed with brass-house trio Too Many Zooz for a Joy Theater stop on the Too Many Flooz Tour.

events.title: Soul Sister Presents HUSTLE! with DJ Soul Sister
events.summary: New Orleans selector DJ Soul Sister brought her HUSTLE! dance party to Tipitina's on January 24, spotlighting soul, funk, and R&B dance-floor sounds.

events.title: Kenny Barron Trio at New Orleans Jazz & Blues Market
events.summary: NEA Jazz Master and pianist Kenny Barron performed at New Orleans Jazz & Blues Market with his trio, including Kiyoshi Kitagawa and Johnathan Blake.

events.title: Leroy Jones & The Preservation Jazz Masters
events.summary: Trumpeter Leroy Jones led The Preservation Jazz Masters in an afternoon Preservation Hall show, with the listed lineup including Daniel Farrow, Katja Toivola, Mike Clement, Jason Stewart, and Brett Gallo.

events.title: Krewe du Vieux Doo - Fête Costumée
events.summary: The official Krewe du Vieux Doo followed the Carnival parade at 2135 Decatur Street, with a music lineup listed as The Rumble, Johnny Sketch and the Dirty Notes, DJ G, and special guests.

events.title: Rockin'1000 U.S. Debut with Harry Connick, Jr.
events.summary: Rockin'1000 made its U.S. debut at Caesars Superdome with 1,000 musicians performing together and Harry Connick, Jr. listed as special guest.
